Fixed. The bug was in `getActiveVersion` (packages/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/src/client/docsClientUtils.ts:62): when the current version's `path` is `/`, `matchPath(pathname, {path: '/'})` matches every pathname, so the current version was always detected as active — freezing the `docsVersionDropdown` label. The fix sorts versions by path length (descending) so the most specific version path is matched first, making `isLast` irrelevant and correctly resolving the active version when one has path `/`.
